name: Alejandra Omaña
summary: Deyci Alejandra Omaña Ortiz, also known as Amaranta Hank, is a Colombian politician and former adult film actress. She began serving as a member of the Senate of Colombia in the 10th Congress of Colombia on July 20, 2026.
